name: WHO Simulation Exercises (SimEx)
description: This benchmark assesses an AI agent's performance across structured public health emergency simulations (tabletop, drills, functional, and full-scale exercises). It measures plan validation, coordination, and capability testing for outbreak and all-hazards response.
reputation: Global standard framework endorsed by the World Health Organization for emergency preparedness and response validation
notes: Framework-based rather than single fixed simulation; evaluates systemic preparedness across multiple exercise types
